title: ConformanceResult
description: Extended. The machine-readable result emitted by the conformance runner (conformance/run.py). It is build-time CI tooling output, not a Weaver runtime contract, but it is a stable inter-repo interchange shape: the self-certification badge (docs/SELF_CERTIFICATION.md) and the public scoreboard (docs/SCOREBOARD.md) consume it, so schematizing it keeps producers and consumers from drifting. See docs/CONFORMANCE.md.

result_version.description: Version of this result format. Bumped only on an intentional shape change.

contract_version.description: The weaver-spec CONTRACT_VERSION the run was performed against.

mode.description: `corpus` when the built-in corpus was run; `bundle` when a single external TraceBundle was checked.

target.description: The bundle path/URL in `bundle` mode; null in `corpus` mode.

status.description: Overall verdict: `pass` iff no checks failed.

failures.description: Count of failed checks (0 iff status is `pass`).

failure_detail.description: Human-readable failure messages (empty when status is `pass`).

failure_records.description: Structured, machine-mappable view of each failure (#145): an agent can map a failure to the offending fixture/field without parsing the human strings. Empty when status is `pass`.

message.description: The same human-readable message as the matching `failure_detail` entry.

payload.description: Repo-relative fixture path or bundle id the failure concerns, when applicable.

schema.description: Schema stem the check validated against, when applicable.

keyword.description: Declared/observed JSON Schema keyword for a schema-level failure, when applicable.

path.description: Location within the payload the failure concerns, when applicable.

invariant_id.description: Invariant id or named check for an invariant-level failure, when applicable.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the result was produced. Used by the freshness policy (docs/SELF_CERTIFICATION.md).

runner.description: Identifier of the tool that produced the result.
